name: API docs drift detector
problem: Diff documentation against a live OpenAPI spec and real traffic, open a PR to fix drift.
limits: Original local FastAPI application and actual HTTP client requests through TestClient, not traffic from a third-party service. Ten independently seeded documentation discrepancies cover paths, methods, operation IDs, parameter schema, response fields, status, requiredness and example types. Evidence retains served OpenAPI, observed traffic, drifted docs and a clean proposed repair. This checks the supported JSON/OpenAPI subset, not arbitrary prose or all OpenAPI features. The repair PR and GitHub Action are demonstrated in this own repository; no external maintainers are contacted.
next: Parse markdown examples, ingest proxy traffic with redaction, and handle composed/nullable schemas.
